(88 nt) could not be designed after exhausting all budget levels (cheap, standard, best_effort with 962 candidates screened). The structure contains multiple crossing pseudoknot interactions — a 7-bp bracket stem crossing the 7-bp parenthesis stem, a 3-bp brace stem, and critically a 2-bp bracket pseudoknot stem ([[...]]), which is too short to be reliably stabilized. No sequence survived the verification panel (pKiss AND ProbKnot AND ShapeKnots). To get a foldable sequence, the structure would need modification: lengthen the 2-bp pseudoknot stem to at least 3–4 bp, or simplify the crossing pattern. As-is, this structure appears to be beyond what current pseudoknot-aware design tools can reliably produce.
